{{Quote|We'll take it from here. Thank you.|Luke Skywalker, to Rommul|<ref name="Allies" />}}
'''Rommul''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] who worked as a guard in the [[Treema Courthouse and Detention Area]] on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]. In [[44 ABY]], he guarded the [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Dyon Stadd]] until [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], arrived to take custody over him. After [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitating]] Stadd out of the well where he was being kept, Luke Skywalker offered to levitate Rommul as well, but the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Abara Mun]] suggested that Rommul would rather use their [[Rope/Legends|rope]] ladder.

==Biography==
{{Quote|We could bring him up. Wouldn't be a problem.''"<br />"''I think Rommul will be happy to emerge the old-fashioned way.|Luke Skywalker and Abara Mun, on Rommul|<ref name="Allies" />}}
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] Rommul served as a guard in the [[Treema Courthouse and Detention Area]] in [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Treema]] by [[44 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Dyon Stadd]] succumbed to a [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] and nearly violated the area surrounding the [[Fountain of Ancients|Fountain of the Hutt Ancients]], a sacred fountain in the [[Derelkoos Desert]]. He was stopped by Klatooinian authorities with the help of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] and taken to the Courthouse and Detention Center, where he was put on sedatives and placed at the bottom of an old well under the watch of Rommul.<ref name="Allies" />

[[File:Luke_Skywalker_EA.jpg|thumb|right|125px|Luke Skywalker]]
Rommul guarded over Stadd until Skywalker and his father, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]], arrived to transfer Stadd to a more secure area aboard their [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Jade Shadow]]''. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Force jump/Legends|jumped]] down into the pit, surprising Rommul, and quickly [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitated]] Stadd up out of the well. Luke Skywalker then offered to levitate Rommul up as well, but the Security and Detention [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Abara Mun]] replied that he would probably rather come up using their [[Rope/Legends|rope]] ladder.<ref name="Allies" />

==Personality and traits==
Rommul was somewhat surprised at the Skywalkers' means of arrival in the well, showing signs of alarm when they Force-leapt down to his side. When Skywalker offered to levitate Rommul out of the pit, Mun replied that she believed Rommul would prefer to return via their rope ladder.<ref name="Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rommul appeared fifth novel of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', written by [[Christie Golden]] and released in [[2010]].<ref name="Allies" />
